title: 10 stars
body: I genuinely love this app to my core. It helps me track my habits and build habits. I’m updated, I don’t have to do the guess work how my previous week looked like. And the app is made so thoughtfully. I love how it looks. Although I was not consistently using it, I would suggest you guys to update on this app regularly even tho you’re not 100% for your habits. You will get there :)
author: Kanasden

title: How to pause habit
body: After new update “pause” button is not available in app. Kindly make it available to pause a habit.
author: MK MISHRA

title: Fantastic app for routine and habits and todos all in one universal system
body: The best app so far which combines recurring habits and to do tasks in one blended display with a very simple and clean experience. The ability to program your day windows and reorder items in time windows is fantastic to give me a truly personalised and custom experience to my taste along with many many custom views of the main screen. My favourite is the compact timeline view.
author: Bkd786

title: Best free app available, other would include in app purchases, but this is completely free!
body: I dont generally write reviews but this app made me do it!…..it is by far the best free app I have used to build and track habits and statistics of my habits and streaks etc.

title: Interface is not good
body: There are tabs at the bottom that are not useful and still we cannot remove them. For e.g feedback. You could have just provided it under setting and not have a tab for it. This looks messy
author: Annie9493

title: Perfect app, needs apple watch connect
body: This app is created with so much attention to detail and has so much to give compared to other apps which don’t really tick all the boxes needed for a routine or habit forming app and just have a lot of unnecessary jazz. Would love if it would work with the Apple Watch, then it would be the most perfect app out there

title: Best app ever!!
body:
Really good! Love all the features!!  Love the multistep timer, the categories option, the timeline, and the performance graphs! All I ever wanted!!! 
Having said that, you could even improve it further if you add an option to share your habits with other habit hub users.
